hypotheses.name: Digital Menu Boards as the First Wedge
hypotheses.description: Determine whether digital menu boards can support Project Sunrise through faster menu and price changes, stronger value communication, improved accuracy, and more consistent execution without requiring an immediate core-POS replacement.
hypotheses.relevant_capability: Genius digital menu boards and content management

hypotheses.name: Post-Acquisition Stack Rationalization
hypotheses.description: Yadav may reassess inherited Del Taco contracts, deployment plans, hardware, data architecture, and vendor overlap as it integrates the brand; the current Qu and NCR estate must be validated before selecting a motion.
hypotheses.likely_buyer: Yadav and Del Taco technology leadership
hypotheses.relevant_capability: Genius restaurant platform, hardware, and integration portfolio

hypotheses.name: Worldpay Relationship Adjacency
hypotheses.description: The signed Worldpay extension and Maggie Lenhart's trusted access may create a coordinated path to Genius discovery, but the extension does not by itself establish customer demand, bundled authority, or a formal sourcing event.
hypotheses.likely_buyer: Daniel Mears and Yadav technology leadership

hypotheses.name: Broader Yadav Portfolio Expansion
